Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S Safety Supervision Daily Inspection Form, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text fields, so this review can confirm that a photo was taken and when, but not what it shows.

91 of 91 submissions read. Both job boards were available — Blake Walton's 11/11/2026 email arrived at 10:04 AM Central with the ArkLaTex and Permian Basin workbooks, and the 11-11 sheet of each was used. 54 manned board rows were checked for coverage: 12 on the ArkLaTex board and 42 on the Permian Basin board, after excluding two ON STANDBY confined space rows, three contingency and shop rows, and the days off and WTX support rows. One further caveat: this review ran at 10:06 PM Central, before the calendar day closed, so any form submitted in the last two hours of 11/11 and any late arrival landing tomorrow morning is not in these counts — the missing Trailer Readiness Forms for trailers 125, 128, 148 and 507 are the findings most likely to be resolved by a late submission.
